name: player_extract_vehicle_name_from_aiv_name
description: Player::ExtractVehicleNameFromAivName copies the vehicle-name prefix from an AIV entry name and stops before an underscore followed by a decimal digit.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Player mission-load/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x423150 validates fastcall ECX=aivName, EDX=outVehicleName, output initialization to an empty string, a byte-copy loop, and a stop condition when the current character is '_' and isdigit(aivName[outLen + 1]) is nonzero.

The native smoke verifies truncation before '_0'-style numeric suffixes, preservation of nonnumeric underscores, immediate empty output for names beginning with a numeric suffix marker, and empty input handling.
